title: Part (e): integral bound for the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ, α a k-covector on ℝ^N (α : Covector (Euclid N) k), f : ℝ → Λ^k(ℝ^N)* continuous, and c ∈ ℝ. Assume α(v) = ∫_0^1 f(t)(v) dt for all v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k, and covectorEuclideanNorm (f t) ≤ c for all t ∈ [0, 1]. Then covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ c. Here covectorEuclideanNorm is SimonGMT's Euclidean coefficient norm √(Σ_{I strictly increasing} α(e_{I_1}, …, e_{I_k})²).
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid N) k) (f : ℝ → Covector (Euclid N) k) (c : ℝ), Continuous f → (∀ v : Fin k → Euclid N, α v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, f t v) → (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, covectorEuclideanNorm (f t) ≤ c) → covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ c
